note: This file is a pure MMDetection configuration file containing only dictionary literals, list literals, and variable assignments. It defines a DDQ-DETR model with a Swin-Large backbone for COCO object detection. There are no functions, classes, or callable APIs — it is not a module that can be invoked via a CLI. No example statements are applicable.
config_description: DDQ-DETR 4-scale with Swin-Large backbone, 30-epoch COCO detection training config
key_components: DDQDETR model with 900 queries and dense query selection (dense_topk_ratio=1.5)
ChannelMapper neck projecting [384, 768, 1536] channels to 256 across 4 scales
DDQDETRHead with FocalLoss, L1Loss, and GIoULoss for 80 COCO classes
Data noise (DN) training with label_noise_scale=0.5 and box_noise_scale=1.0
HungarianAssigner for bipartite matching during training
Multi-scale training pipeline with RandomChoiceResize and RandomCrop augmentations
AdamW optimizer (lr=2e-4) with gradient clipping and backbone lr_mult=0.05
30-epoch schedule with LinearLR warmup and MultiStepLR decay at epochs 20 and 26
